tutorial.foundations: Eight foundations sit in the centre: four ascending from Ace and four descending from King, one per suit.
tutorial.tableau: Sixteen tableau piles surround the foundations. Move the top card to a same-suit neighbour (±1, A↔K wraps).
tutorial.redeal: Stuck? Use one of the three redeals to reverse every tableau pile.
tutorial.controls: Hint, auto-complete, undo, redeal, and give-up sit in the footer.
